# Colin Bamforth

> Author of paramedic thrillers, science-backed stress-management guides and children's books, written by a paramedic with nearly 40 years on the front line in New Zealand, Australia and the UK.

## Key pages

- [Home](https://colinbamforth.com/): author profile, current books and book news.

## Books

- [Finn and the Secret Path](https://colinbamforth.com/finn-and-the-secret-path/): illustrated children's book about a Queensland coal mine, ages 4 to 8 (ISBN 978-1067315405).
- [Standard Operating Silence](https://colinbamforth.com/standard-operating-silence/): emergency-services thriller (ISBN 978-1067101077).
- [Shift Change](https://colinbamforth.com/shift-change/): paramedic fiction, revised second edition (ISBN 978-1067093204).
- [Shift-Worker Stress Workbook](https://colinbamforth.com/shift-worker-stress-workbook/): sleep, decompression and family-life workbook for emergency services and other shift workers (ISBN 978-1067315429).
- [Overwhelmed by Stress? (US Edition)](https://colinbamforth.com/overwhelmed-by-stress-us/): science-backed stress-management guide.
- [Overwhelmed by Stress? (Australia and New Zealand Edition)](https://colinbamforth.com/overwhelmed-by-stress-au-nz/): science-backed stress-management guide (ISBN 978-1067093211).
- [Motorcycle Word Search](https://colinbamforth.com/motorcycle-word-search/), [Construction Word Search](https://colinbamforth.com/construction-word-search/), [Fishing Word Search](https://colinbamforth.com/fishing-word-search/): themed puzzle books.
